messages:
Maya: Thanks everyone for the town hall — quick follow-ups about the review cycle and promo exceptions. Two quick asks: 1) can managers request retroactive promo effective dates? 2) timeline for equity refresh eligibility? 

Sam: +1 on timelines. Also clarifying whether IC->PM role changes use same calibration pool? :thinking: 

Noor: For the retroactive promos — my team had an offer increase that landed after performance signoffs. Are managers able to request backdated comp adjustments? 

Jen: Hi! Short answer: yes, in limited cases. Please file a Promo Exception form (link below), manager + director sign-off required, and HR will assess budget and comp parity. Typical decisions take ~5-7 business days. 

peopleops-bot: Promo Exception form -> https://redwood.corp/hr/forms/promo-exception (internal) :link: 

Alex: Adding on — backdating is allowed only to the start of the current review period (not earlier) unless it's correcting a documented administrative error. We want to avoid retroactive comp that creates cascading band parity issues. 

Lucas: If a promo is backdated, does that affect bonus pool calculations for that quarter? 

Jen: Good Q. Generally no — bonus allocations are based on the original payout period. Backdated base comp changes do not retroactively re-open prior bonus distributions. Exceptions are rare and require finance sign-off. 

Maya: How about IC->PM level moves mentioned — are they calibrated with ICs or managers? We had a mix. 

Sam: our hiring manager moved an IC into PM responsibilities mid-cycle and asked for promo. We want consistent leveling. 

Noor: If role changes are substantive, we recommend treating as a role change rather than a straight promo. That means a separate calibration panel with hiring + people ops + function lead. 

Jen: To be explicit: role-change promotions (IC->Manager/IC->PM) go through a Role Change panel. Calibration criteria include scope, direct reports (if applicable), cross-functional impact, and applied leadership. Use this snippet for managers:

```
Role Change checklist:
- Manager + Director justification
- 3 peer feedbacks
- Updated role profile
- Compensation benchmark attached
```

Alex: For equity refresh eligibility: standard practice is 12–18 months post-last grant for high performers; leadership can make exceptions for retention-critical hires. 

Maya: Is that 12 months from hire or from last grant? 

Jen: From last grant. If someone received a refresh at hire, eligibility clock starts then. 

Lucas: Any change to promotion frequency or comp bands this cycle vs last? 

Jen: No band adjustments this cycle. Band reviews happen annually in Q4; we'll communicate any changes during planning. 

Sam: Thanks — last Q: managers who missed the calibration deadline — can they still submit nominations? 

peopleops-bot: Late submissions accepted on a case-by-case basis; please tag @jen and cc your director. Late forms get lower priority and may be moved to the next cycle. 

Maya: Awesome, thanks for the clarity. I'll resend guidance to my managers and include the form link. :thumbsup:

Jen: Happy to help — ping me if you need specific examples or redlines for manager write-ups. 

Noor: Thanks everyone — very helpful.
